verdict.rationale: Teams documents Outgoing Webhooks, a first-party mechanism that sends channel text messages out to an external web service, which is a narrow form of event subscription. Incoming Webhooks and Connectors only push content into Teams, so they do not count as outbound event delivery. Missing for 10: broad event-type subscriptions (e.g., Graph change notifications for chats, membership or meetings), documentation of payload/registration/validation details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: With Outgoing Webhooks, you can send text messages from a channel to a web service.
Webhooks and connectors help to connect the web services to channels and teams in Microsoft Teams.
